note: I think we say this multi-verse malarkey which has taken Hollywood by storm is what was a real distraction. Did you know that Erwin Schrödinger meant his cat as a joke to point out how ridiculous it is to be in two places at once? It's not that it's in two places at once, it's that it's not decided yet. And the important point of this is that we're not trying to really explain everything. We are trying to simply focus the viewer onto the next point.
